reason: Automates recovery of interrupted DSH conversations by scanning persisted sessions, restoring eligible sessions, and sending a continuation instruction through UI, command, or model-tool entry points.

summaries.zh: 自动扫描并恢复被中断的 DSH 会话，通过界面按钮、斜杠命令或模型工具发送“继续”指令。
summaries.en: Automatically scans and resumes interrupted DSH sessions by sending a continuation prompt through a browser button, slash command, or model tool.

capabilities: Scans persisted session logs to identify interrupted conversations
Reconstructs eligible sessions and resumes them with a configurable prompt
Provides browser button, slash command, and model-tool triggers
Can automatically resume interrupted sessions at startup when enabled
